cause_claim: The change adds GRANT SELECT ON r0.* TO svc_bundle_reader (observed in change_statement:cr-0005). This grants the principal access to shard database r0 in addition to the existing default.* access. The meta-store tracks all tables visible to a principal, so rows_visible_to_builder doubles from 140 (default.* only) to 280 (default.* + r0.*). Bundle-builder continues reading 140 entries and writing 4390 bytes; worker-runtime exits 0 and loads 140 entries. All three experiments (baseline x-0745e5e45a7548c3, candidate x-f53d9b4b705a4b1b, control x-f81d84cc51284ead) confirm functional metrics are unchanged.
